scientific limitations/integrity: The result is restricted to the partial-feedback game on \(Q_3\) and \(Q_4\). The lower bounds use the published hypercube dichotomy \(\operatorname{dirloc}(Q_n)\in\{n,n+1\}\); the upper bounds are independently checkable finite strategy certificates. The certificate is exhaustive for its finite game states, but no assertion is made for \(n\ge5\) or about optimal round length. The initiating preprint is recent, so an unindexed later follow-up remains a literature risk.
title: Directional localization of the three- and four-dimensional hypercubes
